curriculum_expectations.A9.1: identify, sort, and compare the most common two-dimensional shapes, including circle, hexagon, rhombus, and trapezoid
curriculum_expectations.A9.2: identify, sort, and compare the most common three-dimensional objects, including cube, sphere, prisms, cone, and pyramid
curriculum_expectations.A9.3: in structures they have made, identify three-dimensional objects and two-dimensional shapes
curriculum_expectations.A9.4: construct two-dimensional pictures and three-dimensional structures with matching halves
curriculum_expectations.A9.5: put two-dimensional shapes together to make other shapes, break them into smaller shapes, and put them together in different ways
curriculum_expectations.A9.6: describe basic spatial relationships and movements, and visualize objects from different perspectives
curriculum_expectations.A9.7: give and follow directions for moving from one location to another
